name: Kozminski University
summary: Private business university in Warsaw, founded in 1993, about 12,000 students on one campus; English bachelor's in management and finance.

ib.text: Your three best IB exam subjects convert to points (HL 7 = 200, SL 7 = 150); English programmes need at least 350, e.g. three SL 6s. The IB Diploma counts as proof of English.

lastYear.text: round 1: 2 Mar–4 May; round 2: 5 May–15 July; then rolling

programmes.name: Bachelor in Management
programmes.about: Management, finance, accounting and HR with courses on generative AI for managers; pick a major in marketing, international management, entrepreneurship or luxury management, with a fifth-semester exchange window and double degrees with partner schools.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on 3 IB exam subjects (HL 7 = 200, SL 7 = 150 pts); 350 needed. Rounds run until places fill. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

family.name: Bachelor in Management
family.differs: Three years in Warsaw with a major in marketing, international management, entrepreneurship or luxury management; 19,400 PLN a semester in year 1.

programmes.name: Sustainable Business - Major on the Bachelor in Management Program
programmes.about: The Management degree's sustainability major with ESCP Business School: year one in Warsaw, then ESCP campuses such as Madrid, Turin, Paris, Berlin or London, covering ESG, green economics and sustainable business models, and ending with two diplomas.
programmes.ib: An online interview on motivation and fit follows the document check.
programmes.selectionNote: IB results checked (350 points minimum), then an online interview on motivation, fit and openness to moving campus; 20 places. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

family.name: Bachelor in Management
family.differs: Year one in Warsaw, then two years on ESCP campuses; double degree; interview; 20 places; €20,100 in year 1 plus a €2,400 ESCP deposit.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Management and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: Management combined with programming (mainly Python and R), data analytics and machine learning used in business, with group start-up or implementation projects under staff supervision from the second semester.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on 3 IB exam subjects (HL 7 = 200, SL 7 = 150 pts); 350 needed. Rounds run until places fill. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

separateFrom.name: Bachelor in Management
separateFrom.reason: A separate degree with its own curriculum: programming in Python and R, data analytics and machine learning, and a start-up project; you choose it as its own programme in the portal.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Management and Sociology in Business and Media
programmes.about: Management joined with the sociology of media and digital technology: many discussion and workshop classes, content creation, research and communication skills, and required internships in traditional and new media.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on 3 IB exam subjects (HL 7 = 200, SL 7 = 150 pts); 350 needed. Rounds run until places fill. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

separateFrom.name: Bachelor in Management
separateFrom.reason: A separate degree combining management with the sociology of media and digital technology, with media internships; you choose it as its own programme in the portal.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Finance and Accounting
programmes.about: Finance and accounting with sustainability and digital finance built in: majors in corporate finance and financial markets, green finance, or fintech, preparation for the CFA Investment Foundations certificate, and double degrees at ISEG, Aston or IESEG.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on 3 IB exam subjects (HL 7 = 200, SL 7 = 150 pts); 350 needed. Rounds run until places fill. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: One fee for everyone, Polish or not: 19,400 PLN a semester in year 1, rising to 21,400 and 23,400 PLN in years 2 and 3 (2026/27).
Admission runs in rounds: two ranked rounds, then first-come until places fill, so apply in an early round rather than waiting for the last one.
School documents from the EU, EFTA or OECD need no NAWA statement and skip the short online knowledge test other applicants must pass.
